text.title: Content Refresh SOP Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable content-refresh signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the URL tagged evergreen AND is `url_age_months` at least 12?

conclusion.verdict: not eligible for the refresh matrix; leave out of the queue and record why

branch.question: Does the URL row carry GSC (clicks, impressions, position), GA4 (landing-page sessions, key events) and rank-tracker position over the same trailing window and the prior window?

conclusion.verdict: do not score; complete the dataset from a persisted export first

branch.question: Which verdict do the thresholded signals (impressions trend, top-position decay, intent shift) produce?

conclusion.verdict: write the numeric thresholds into decision_branches before scoring
name survivor URL, redirect map (301) and internal-link rewrite
410, drop from sitemap and navigation; no homepage redirect
record leave with reason and next-review date

branch.when: verdict == refresh AND (url_unchanged == false OR date_bump_only == true)

conclusion.verdict: keep the URL; change the date only with substantive edits
record the 28-day baseline and schedule the day-90 re-score

branch.when: verdict == refresh AND url_unchanged == true AND baseline_recorded == true

conclusion.verdict: run all nine steps with exit criteria; log any skipped step

text.example: evergreen=true, url_age_months=19 -> dataset_sources=3 -> thresholds_recorded=true, verdict=refresh -> url_unchanged=true, baseline_recorded=true -> conclusion ref=r-nine-step-checklist-complete
